scope: Typed graph-only category search and certificate construction; no source adapter, INT/EXT/PREFIX/NoConflict or full six-model acceptance
checkedInvariants: Each D edge maps previous-D and previous-RW states to target previous-D; each RW maps previous-D only to target previous-RW. Closed state walks therefore exclude adjacent RW including the closing pair.
Item-RW marks require at least one item edge but retain predicate-RW return paths.
D-only cycles also refute RC and are combined into stronger graph constraints.
Generalized SI excludes RT; strict graph preserves RT as a separate original kind.
Macro rotation starts at D and groups only D or D;RW while preserving every original source record and cyclic expansion.
Partial graph construction or SCC/witness BFS exhaustion never yields an absence claim.
Incomplete supplied graphs may retain positive closed-walk evidence but never absence; modelCoverageAccepted remains false.
The graph kernel does not authenticate edge sources or infer raw transaction/version order.

findings.detail: Parent-chain recovery and original-edge/macro expansion visit edge indices without cg_tick, while execution.scope explicitly includes witness recovery. Returned counters therefore do not charge every operation advertised by the scope.
findings.remedy: Charge the defined witness recovery/expansion visits and return inconclusive with no partial certificate on exhaustion, or explicitly narrow the contract to bounded materialization outside maxEdgeScans. Add exact cycle recovery boundary fixtures; preserve existing independent expectations and old receipt.
